minors.issue: The load generator started by startLoad is only stopped on the success path. A t.Fatalf in tenDeploys, deploy or switchTo skips l.stop(), so the ticker goroutine keeps sending requests until the test process exits.
minors.scenario: Deploy(r04) fails in TestTenDeploysUnderLoadDropNothing: the test fails and the proxy is stopped, but the load goroutine keeps dialling the closed port 50 times a second while TestRollbackUnderLoadIsUnderFiveSeconds runs in parallel. Only CPU and noise; no assertion is affected.
